protocol.interpretation: Continuous controller state across six independently recorded LLM streams. Not a continuous LLM context. Same common activity for every condition after warm-up.
protocol.selection: Cohorts, lengths, controls and warm-up selection fixed before running. Unusual cases require replay and causal tests; no self-awareness endpoint is assumed.

selection.selection: largest robust nearest-neighbor phenotype distance among basic-dynamics-filtered own trajectories, plus median/persistent/representative controls
selection.interpretation: unusual among these 32 own trajectories; not a confirmed rare phenotype or self-awareness result

warnings: recorded LLM contexts reset between streams
larger cohort is not social interaction; copies have independent online states apart from calibration and comparison
rank is exploratory; ordinary controls and replay decide its meaning
linear dimensions and distances are not counts of mental faculties
